item.title: Apple Appeals $1.8 Billion UK App Store Antitrust Ruling

item.title: iPhone 17 Pro and iPhone 17 Pro Max Users Complain of Static From Speaker While Charging

item.title: Apple Raises $3 Million for Global Fund’s Fight Against AIDS Via Apple Pay Promo
item.description: During the holiday shopping season, Apple donated $5 to The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria for every Apple Pay purchase made on Apple.com, or in the Apple Store app or in an Apple retail store.Read More...
